caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged on a light beige background. In the center and occupying the majority of the composition is a detailed rendering of a clear, cut-glass bowl with diamond-like patterns along its sides; it is rectangular with rounded edges and has a faceted texture. The bowl is contained within a larger rectangle drawn with fine lines. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller square containing a side view of a glass bowl, which is circular with vertical ridges and a scalloped rim. In the lower right corner, another small square shows a close-up detail of an oval-shaped leaf or petal motif with radial grooves converging at a central point. The objects are illustrated primarily with shades of gray and white, simulating reflections and refractions typical of glass. There is a signature reading "Livingstone" at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Glass Bowl
